package nats

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"log"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	natsgo "github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
)

const (
	TeacherEventsStream              = "TEACHER_EVENTS"
	TeacherAssistanceConsumerQueue   = "ms-student-teacher-assistance"
	TeacherAssistanceConsumerDurable = "ms-student-teacher-assistance-v1"
)

type teacherEventEnvelope struct {
	EventID       string          `json:"event_id"`
	EventType     string          `json:"event_type"`
	CorrelationID string          `json:"correlation_id"`
	CausationID   string          `json:"causation_id"`
	StudentID     string          `json:"student_id"`
	OccurredAt    time.Time       `json:"occurred_at"`
	SchemaVersion int             `json:"schema_version"`
	Data          json.RawMessage `json:"data"`
}

type teacherAssistanceData struct {
	LearningActionID string                                `json:"learning_action_id"`
	ContextType      domain.LearningContextType            `json:"context_type"`
	ContextID        string                                `json:"context_id"`
	SupportContext   domain.TeacherSupportContext          `json:"support_context"`
	HintsUsed        int                                   `json:"hints_used"`
	MaxHintLevel     *int                                  `json:"max_hint_level"`
	InterventionUsed bool                                  `json:"intervention_used"`
	Observations     []domain.TeacherAssistanceObservation `json:"observations"`
	PolicyVersion    string                                `json:"policy_version"`
}

// DecodeTeacherAssistanceEvent validates the versioned producer envelope and
// returns the student-owned projection input.
func DecodeTeacherAssistanceEvent(payload []byte) (domain.TeacherAssistance, error) {
	var envelope teacherEventEnvelope
	if err := decodeTeacherJSON(payload, &envelope); err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherAssistance{}, fmt.Errorf("decode teacher event envelope: %w", err)
	}
	if envelope.EventType != domain.SubjectTeacherAssistanceObserved {
		return domain.TeacherAssistance{}, errors.New("unsupported teacher event type")
	}
	if envelope.SchemaVersion != domain.TeacherAssistanceObservedSchemaVersion {
		return domain.TeacherAssistance{}, errors.New("unsupported teacher assistance schema version")
	}

	var data teacherAssistanceData
	if err := decodeTeacherJSON(envelope.Data, &data); err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherAssistance{}, fmt.Errorf("decode teacher assistance data: %w", err)
	}
	return domain.NewTeacherAssistance(domain.TeacherAssistance{
		EventID:          envelope.EventID,
		StudentID:        envelope.StudentID,
		CorrelationID:    envelope.CorrelationID,
		CausationID:      envelope.CausationID,
		LearningActionID: data.LearningActionID,
		ContextType:      data.ContextType,
		ContextID:        data.ContextID,
		SupportContext:   data.SupportContext,
		HintsUsed:        data.HintsUsed,
		MaxHintLevel:     data.MaxHintLevel,
		InterventionUsed: data.InterventionUsed,
		Observations:     data.Observations,
		PolicyVersion:    data.PolicyVersion,
		OccurredAt:       envelope.OccurredAt,
	})
}

func decodeTeacherJSON(payload []byte, target any) error {
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(payload))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		if err == nil {
			return errors.New("multiple JSON values")
		}
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

// TeacherAssistanceSubscriber consumes durable teacher assistance summaries.
// Invalid versioned payloads are terminated; persistence errors are retried.
type TeacherAssistanceSubscriber struct {
	Conn       *natsgo.Conn
	Handler    func(context.Context, domain.TeacherAssistance) (bool, error)
	AckWait    time.Duration
	RetryDelay time.Duration
}

func (subscriber TeacherAssistanceSubscriber) Subscribe(ctx context.Context) error {
	if subscriber.Conn == nil {
		return errors.New("teacher assistance subscriber connection is required")
	}
	if subscriber.Handler == nil {
		return errors.New("teacher assistance subscriber handler is required")
	}
	ackWait := subscriber.AckWait
	if ackWait <= 0 {
		ackWait = 30 * time.Second
	}
	retryDelay := subscriber.RetryDelay
	if retryDelay <= 0 {
		retryDelay = 5 * time.Second
	}
	js, err := subscriber.Conn.JetStream()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = js.QueueSubscribe(
		domain.SubjectTeacherAssistanceObserved,
		TeacherAssistanceConsumerQueue,
		func(message *natsgo.Msg) {
			assistance, decodeErr := DecodeTeacherAssistanceEvent(message.Data)
			if decodeErr != nil {
				log.Printf("terminate invalid teacher assistance event: %v", decodeErr)
				if termErr := message.Term(); termErr != nil {
					log.Printf("terminate teacher assistance event: %v", termErr)
				}
				return
			}
			if _, handleErr := subscriber.Handler(ctx, assistance); handleErr != nil {
				if errors.Is(handleErr, domain.ErrEvidenceContract) {
					log.Printf("terminate mismatched teacher assistance event %s: %v", assistance.EventID, handleErr)
					if termErr := message.Term(); termErr != nil {
						log.Printf("terminate teacher assistance event %s: %v", assistance.EventID, termErr)
					}
					return
				}
				log.Printf("retry teacher assistance event %s: %v", assistance.EventID, handleErr)
				if nakErr := message.NakWithDelay(retryDelay); nakErr != nil {
					log.Printf("nak teacher assistance event %s: %v", assistance.EventID, nakErr)
				}
				return
			}
			if ackErr := message.AckSync(); ackErr != nil {
				log.Printf("ack teacher assistance event %s: %v", assistance.EventID, ackErr)
			}
		},
		natsgo.BindStream(TeacherEventsStream),
		natsgo.Durable(TeacherAssistanceConsumerDurable),
		natsgo.ManualAck(),
		natsgo.AckExplicit(),
		natsgo.DeliverAll(),
		natsgo.AckWait(ackWait),
	)
	return err
}
